_meta.purpose: Source adapter, hierarchy, validation, lineage, and governance configuration for SCIP vNext.
_meta.edit_rule: Only Priyanuj or Claude edits this file. One entry per R-series report. Add/remove entries here when new reports are onboarded or retired. Never touch data_loader.py for a column rename.
_meta.format_rule: All source files are xlsx. openpyxl reads them. Multi-sheet files use sheet_name param. No xlsb, PDF, or Word accepted.
_meta.unit_rule: All monetary output from data_loader is in AED base units (not millions). utils.fmt_aed_millions() handles display conversion.
_meta.naming_convention: snake_case throughout. _aed suffix = AED base units. _pct suffix = 0-100 scale. _m suffix FORBIDDEN in this config — all values are base AED.

changelog.v7: R18 entry fully rebuilt. Reflects actual file structure: multi-sheet workbook, active sheet = Overdue-1, positional column reads (not header-name reads), Grand Total row for OD_TODAY and ageing buckets, Sub Total rows (A-E/F/G) for entity OD. SNAPSHOT_DATE read from header cell. Flat column_map removed — replaced with positional_read spec.
changelog.v8: Adds locked Group > Sobha/UAQ entity hierarchy, Sobha AUH handling, source-adapter declarations, lineage contract, quality gates, and updated R18/R02/R04/R08/R36 read profiles based on May 2026 sample files.

R18.label: R18 Consolidated & Overdue — Master OD Report with Sobha/UAQ hierarchy
R18.authority: Single source of truth for OD_TODAY, OD_GROUP, OD_SOBHA, OD_SOBHA_DUBAI, OD_SOBHA_AUH, OD_UAQ, OD_SINIYA, OD_DOWNTOWN_UAQ and OD ageing.
R18._read_strategy: ADAPTER: positional row scan via source_adapters.R18OverdueAdapter. Do not read this sheet as a flat header table.

sheet_structure.header_date_cell: Read snapshot date from a header cell (row 0 or 1) — exact cell confirmed on first file inspection. Store as SNAPSHOT_DATE. Never hardcode.
sheet_structure.col_index_note: Column indices are 0-based as returned by openpyxl iter_rows(values_only=True).

positional_columns.col_3: row_label usually lives here; adapter scans every cell in row for robustness

sobha_subtotals.note: Sections A through E = Sobha entity. Sum col[14] across all five Sub Total rows.

siniya_subtotal.note: Section F = Siniya entity. Single Sub Total row.

dt_subtotal.note: Section G = Downtown UAQ entity. Single Sub Total row.

OD_DT.note: Backward-compatible alias only. UI should display Downtown UAQ.

rules.formula: Sub Total A-H must be found

validation_check.on_fail: Do not silently fallback. Set live_warning/unavailable and expose lineage issue.

R18.data_loader_implementation_note: data_loader.py must NOT attempt to read R18 as a flat DataFrame with pd.read_excel(). Use openpyxl directly: wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True); ws = wb['Overdue-1']; then scan rows using iter_rows(values_only=True) matching col[0] against row_identification patterns. Extract col[14] and cols[8-13] from matched rows only.
